keys: My sister lives there. She bakes the most delicious cookies! The flour I get is shipped from her bakery.
en: My sister lives there. She bakes the most delicious cookies! The flour I get is shipped from her bakery.
zh: 我妹妹就住在那儿。她烤的饼干最好吃！我收的面粉就是从她的面包房运来的。

keys: A delivery arrived at the docks this morning, but walking back and forth in this heat is exhausting.
en: A delivery arrived at the docks this morning, but walking back and forth in this heat is exhausting.
zh: 今天早上码头到了一批货，但这鬼天气来回跑一趟真是累人。

keys: Ah, welcome! I'm afraid the shelves are empty at the moment.
en: Ah, welcome! I'm afraid the shelves are empty at the moment.
zh: 啊，欢迎！可惜货架现在空着呢。

keys: Any luck at the docks? Look for barrels marked with a blue seal.
en: Any luck at the docks? Look for barrels marked with a blue seal.
zh: 码头有收获吗？找带蓝色蜡封的桶。

keys: But grain? Tonori has never been the place to grow grain. Without the trade ships, this city would go hungry.
en: But grain? Tonori has never been the place to grow grain. Without the trade ships, this city would go hungry.
zh: 可粮食呢？托诺里从来不是产粮的地方。没有商船，全城都得挨饿。

keys: Cactus, mostly. Hardy plants, and we make good use of them. Candy, drinks, even medicine.
en: Cactus, mostly. Hardy plants, and we make good use of them. Candy, drinks, even medicine.
zh: 大多是仙人掌。这种植物很皮实，我们把它用了个遍：糖果、饮料，甚至药材。

keys: Even in this heat, a warm loaf of bread is hard to pass on.
en: Even in this heat, a warm loaf of bread is hard to pass on.
zh: 这么热的天，一块热面包还是让人难以拒绝。

keys: Free up some space and come back.
en: Free up some space and come back.
zh: 腾点地方再回来吧。

keys: Great port city across the ocean, on the Aurora coast. Rich farmland, skilled artisans.
en: Great port city across the ocean, on the Aurora coast. Rich farmland, skilled artisans.
zh: 大洋彼岸的良港，就在欧若拉海岸。沃野千里，能工巧匠云集。

keys: Have you checked the docks? The flour sacks should be inside the barrel with the blue seal.
en: Have you checked the docks? The flour sacks should be inside the barrel with the blue seal.
zh: 码头找过了吗？面粉袋应该在带蓝色蜡封的桶里。

keys: Here, take some of my best. Croissants and cactus candy. One is a family recipe and the other one is a specialty of Tulimshar!
en: Here, take some of my best. Croissants and cactus candy. One is a family recipe and the other one is a specialty of Tulimshar!
zh: 来，拿点我最拿手的。羊角包和仙人掌糖，一个是家传配方，另一个是图利姆沙尔的特产！

keys: I have my flour shipped in from Artis to keep my bakery running. My Sandstorm Bread has fed this city for many years.
en: I have my flour shipped in from Artis to keep my bakery running. My Sandstorm Bread has fed this city for many years.
zh: 我的面粉都是从阿蒂斯运来的，面包房才开得下去。我的沙暴面包养活了这座城市很多年。

keys: I'll have the ovens hot and ready.
en: I'll have the ovens hot and ready.
zh: 我会把烤炉预热好的。

keys: If I go myself, I'll be too tired to bake anything today.
en: If I go myself, I'll be too tired to bake anything today.
zh: 要是我自己去，今天就没力气烤面包了。

keys: It also keeps us fed, but for a business like mine it means always waiting on the next ship to come in.
en: It also keeps us fed, but for a business like mine it means always waiting on the next ship to come in.
zh: 这也养活了我们。不过对我这样的买卖来说，就意味着永远在等下一班船进港。

keys: Look for the deep blue seal. You can't miss it.
en: Look for the deep blue seal. You can't miss it.
zh: 找深蓝色蜡封就行，一眼就能认出来。

keys: Much appreciated, friend.
en: Much appreciated, friend.
zh: 感激不尽，朋友。

keys: My signature recipe! Flour from Artis, cactus juice instead of regular water and a pinch of desert salt.
en: My signature recipe! Flour from Artis, cactus juice instead of regular water and a pinch of desert salt.
zh: 我的招牌配方！阿蒂斯面粉，用仙人掌汁代替清水，再加一撮沙漠盐。

keys: No trouble. The ovens will wait, then.
en: No trouble. The ovens will wait, then.
zh: 没关系，烤炉可以先等等。

keys: Stop by anytime. There's always a fresh loaf waiting.
en: Stop by anytime. There's always a fresh loaf waiting.
zh: 随时来坐坐。总有新鲜面包等着你。

keys: The barrels from the Artis bakery are marked by a blue wax seal. Could you bring me the flour bags that are inside?
en: The barrels from the Artis bakery are marked by a blue wax seal. Could you bring me the flour bags that are inside?
zh: 阿蒂斯面包房的桶上有蓝色蜡封。你能帮我把里面的面粉袋带回来吗？

keys: The crust holds through sandstorms and still tastes fresh the next morning. That's how it earned the name.
en: The crust holds through sandstorms and still tastes fresh the next morning. That's how it earned the name.
zh: 这种面包皮扛得住沙暴，第二天早上依然新鲜。名字就是这么来的。

keys: The merchant ships from Artis keep half of Tulimshar's market stocked. Without them, we'd have little more than cactus to eat.
en: The merchant ships from Artis keep half of Tulimshar's market stocked. Without them, we'd have little more than cactus to eat.
zh: 阿蒂斯的商船养活了图利姆沙尔半个集市。没有它们，我们除了仙人掌几乎没别的可吃。

keys: Trading. It has always been Tulimshar's greatest skill. How else does a city like this thrive in a windy desert valley?
en: Trading. It has always been Tulimshar's greatest skill. How else does a city like this thrive in a windy desert valley?
zh: 做生意。这从来都是图利姆沙尔最大的本事。不然这样一座城怎么能在风沙河谷里活下来？

keys: Tulimshar doesn't have any good farmland. As you can see around you, we're in a desert. Nothing grows out here but cactus.
en: Tulimshar doesn't have any good farmland. As you can see around you, we're in a desert. Nothing grows out here but cactus.
zh: 图利姆沙尔没有像样的农田。看看四周就明白，我们身在沙漠里，除了仙人掌什么都不长。

keys: We sit at the crossroads of three continents. Everything passes through Tulimshar's port sooner or later.
en: We sit at the crossroads of three continents. Everything passes through Tulimshar's port sooner or later.
zh: 我们坐拥三大洲的十字路口。所有货物流转迟早都要经过图利姆沙尔的港口。

keys: With this flour, Tulimshar will have fresh Sandstorm Bread by sundown.
en: With this flour, Tulimshar will have fresh Sandstorm Bread by sundown.
zh: 有了这些面粉，日落前全城就能吃上新鲜的沙暴面包了。

keys: You found them! But it looks like your bag is too full for me to give you anything in return.
en: You found them! But it looks like your bag is too full for me to give you anything in return.
zh: 你找到了！不过你的包看起来太满了，我没法再塞报酬给你。

keys: You found them! Wonderful.
en: You found them! Wonderful.
zh: 你找到了！太好了。
